environment.full_build_flags: Not distributed in wheel; compiler string is evidence, not complete build provenance.

profile_interpretation: Default is the actual installed DLL dispatch. Alternate is a process-local compatible exported-kernel/threshold profile, not a rebuilt or optimally tuned Tiger Lake library. No installed file changes.

method.sampling_order: Seeded shuffle of sizes, methods, profiles and operand pairs within every round; repeated hot operands inside each batch.
method.validation: Every operand pair independently multiplied by Python int outside timers; each timed batch final full product checked outside timer.
method.native_mpz_reuse: Native x64 loop calls __gmpz_mul into a preinitialized sufficiently allocated result. Inputs/import/conversion excluded. GMP internal scratch allocation remains included.
method.native_mpn_preallocated: Native x64 loop calls __gmpn_mul_n with preallocated result limbs. Inputs distinct, positive, exact stated bit length, not squaring. GMP internal scratch allocation remains included.
method.gmpy2_allocating: Serial Python loop a*b; includes Python iteration/binding and result allocation/release. Input conversion and correctness excluded.
method.native_batch_overhead: Includes one indirect call, loop decrement/branch and argument moves per GMP call; no per-product Python or ctypes crossing. No subtraction of estimated overhead.
method.native_wrapper_tests: repeat3 callback 17 calls and repeat4 callback 19 calls with exact arguments; full product validation on all cases/profiles/methods.
method.cache: hot repeated operands/code within batch; cache state between batches uncontrolled
method.scope: Finite machine/installation measurements, not rigorous runtime bounds, not an asymptotic fit, not an executable PR4470 comparison.
